Container.Name: vfe-docker-unraid-migrator
Container.Overview: VFE Docker Unraid Migrator 0.0.1. Bidirectionally migrates one Docker container and its persistent data between two paired Unraid servers on a trusted LAN. Includes seven image-handling modes and interactive conflict resolution. Install the same agent on both servers.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Local Docker Engine socket. Grants powerful host-level Docker control.

Config.Name: Unraid Storage Root
Config.Description: Provides access to appdata and other selected /mnt paths.

Config.Name: Docker Volumes
Config.Description: Required only when migrating Docker named volumes.

Config.Name: Unraid User Templates
Config.Description: Reads the source template and writes the migrated template.

Config.Name: Host Devices
Config.Description: Allows destination preflight to verify GPU, USB and other device paths.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Pairing records, settings, job history and temporary migration state.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host-network Web UI and peer API port. Must be unused on each server.

Config.Name: Transfer Port
Config.Description: Temporary authenticated rsync receiver port. Allow this port between both LAN IPs.

Config.Name: Image Pull Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds to wait for a destination registry pull before failing with a clear error. Use image transfer mode when the registry is unavailable.

Config.Name: Stop Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds Docker waits for a graceful source-container shutdown.
